name: Pencil Notes
tagline: dashi's hand-drawn notes: paper, ink-blue, pencil greys and one orange, Kalam handwriting, a pen that writes as you speak.

motion.direction: dashi hand-drawn notes. Ruled notebook paper, ink-blue `ink` handwriting (Kalam 700, subtitles ≥ 60 px), pencil greys `goldd` for sketches, ONE orange `ter` as accent A and ink-blue as accent B — the two core nouns keep their colours in picture, data and captions; a grainy stamp title (`stamp`, 104–112 px). The pen writes as the speaker talks (`draw`), lines 0.3–0.75 s, pops 0.2–0.45 s outBack, scene change 0.6–0.7 s inOutCubic, a slow push 1–1.5 %/s; the camera glides down the note. Hold after reveal = chars/9 + 0.5 s; something new every 2–3 s, never static > 2 s. Pencil doodles in the margins; no gradients.
